test.title: The tallest tree in the valley

paragraphs.text: A fir measured last autumn turned out to be 62 metres tall, the tallest recorded in the valley. It stands on private land, and the owner has asked that its exact position is not published.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Foresters believe the tree is about 250 years old. Its top was damaged in a storm in 2018 but has since recovered, and the tree is expected to keep growing for several decades.
paragraphs.label: B

document.title: The tallest tree in the valley

items.prompt: The fir is the tallest tree in the country.
Visitors are told where the tree grows.
The tree is more than 200 years old.
The storm of 2018 damaged several trees in the valley.
